name: print-social-next-stage-of-digital-business-post-with-violet-planet-edges
title: 'The Next Stage of Digital Business' post with glowing violet planet edges and a split CTA
whatItIs: A square dark violet post on a faint dot grid with two huge glowing violet spheres cropped at left and right edges, a white four-point star, a centred headline and subline, and a split pill CTA ('Get a fresh look »' plus a glowing 'Get started' button with a hand cursor).
whatItMeans: Futuristic and inviting; the framing planets make the message feel like a portal.
techniques: Crop two glowing spheres at opposite edges to frame text.
Build a split CTA with a prompt and a button.
Add a hand cursor to imply clicking.

vocabulary.definition: A pill with a text prompt and a button.
A shape cut by the frame edge.
